asm_ida_com:
push    rbp
mov     rbp, rsp
mov     [rbp+nr], edi
mov     [rbp+addr], rsi
mov     eax, [rbp+nr]
mov     ecx, 20h ; ' '
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     eax, edx
mov     ecx, eax
mov     eax, 1
shl     rax, cl
mov     [rbp+mask], rax
mov     rax, [rbp+addr]
mov     [rbp+var_28], rax
mov     eax, [rbp+nr]
mov     ecx, 20h ; ' '
cdq
idiv    ecx
mov     ecx, eax
mov     rax, [rbp+var_28]
movsxd  rcx, ecx
shl     rcx, 3
add     rax, rcx
mov     [rbp+p], rax
mov     rcx, [rbp+mask]
mov     rax, [rbp+p]
or      rcx, [rax]
mov     [rax], rcx
pop     rbp
retn
